description: Discord is a communication platform for communities, games, and apps, with developer features for bots, server integrations, activities, and social/game platform features. Developers can build applications that interact with Discord servers, users, and events over HTTP and webhooks.
summary: Discord exposes a REST HTTP API on `https://discord.com/api` authenticated by bot tokens or OAuth2 bearer tokens, plus tokenized incoming webhook endpoints that can be called without separate auth. I found no Discord-hosted GraphQL API, MCP server, or official developer CLI on `discord.com`.
